card.name: Digits inside numbers in doses and Malay text
card.fires_on: Single digits or number pieces in the middle of a multi-digit number or dosing table, such as the 4 in 104°F or the 1 in a weight-band row. Also a few Malay or Indonesian word pieces.

modes.label: Digits in numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a larger number, often a temperature or year count.
modes.example: do not exceed a temperature of 10<<4>>°F (40°C)

modes.label: Dose table cells
modes.description: The leading number of a dose amount in a weight-based teaspoonful table.

modes.label: Malay text pieces
modes.description: Pieces of Malay words or numbers in Malay sentences.

card.writes: It seems to push toward Malay or Indonesian word beginnings like dit, jam, send, and bes, and away from pend and ter pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on a digit in the middle of a number, mostly in dose tables and temperatures, and sometimes in Malay text.
